mcp_tool_local_search_desc:
Search the user's local chat history by keywords and open the results page.
[How to use] Break the user's natural-language search intent into multiple possible keywords and put them in the keywords array.
[OR matching] Keywords are OR'd — a hit on any one is enough, so include synonyms, aliases, and related terms to improve recall. Example: "find the renovation chats with Lao Wang" → ["Lao Wang","renovation","house","construction","quote"]; "the meeting link I sent last time" → ["meeting","Tencent Meeting","zoom","link"].
[Matching] Case-insensitive substring match. No quoted phrases, wildcards, regex, AND, or field filters — keywords are plain substrings.
[Scope] Session title / peer nickname / username / last message, plus message body.
[Choosing keywords] Use content words (names, nicknames, topics, places, proper nouns). Drop filler words like "the", "that", "those", "records".
mcp_tool_local_search_keywords_desc: Possible keywords, OR'd together (a hit on any one is enough). Expand the user's intent into synonyms and related terms; each item is one keyword for substring matching.

app_agreement_notice_item_3: If you detect fraud, harassment, inducement, or other suspicious behavior, stop interacting immediately and preserve evidence.
app_agreement_section_positioning_body_1: This APP primarily provides instant communication, message delivery, and conversation collaboration capabilities. Its core role is to help users establish and maintain communication links.
app_agreement_section_positioning_body_2: Because the APP is communication-oriented, any trust judgment, identity verification, or intention assessment involving chat counterparts must be completed by the user independently.
app_agreement_section_risk_body_1: You understand and acknowledge that user-generated communication content may involve identity disguise, false information, harassment, inducement, or dispute risks.
app_agreement_section_risk_body_2: Unless otherwise required by law, losses or consequences arising from your own communication decisions are your responsibility.
app_agreement_section_risk_bullet_1: Do not easily trust identity statements, promises, screenshots, or verbal commitments made in chats.
app_agreement_section_risk_bullet_2: Be cautious when opening third-party links, QR codes, shared files, or external contact channels sent through conversations.
app_agreement_section_risk_bullet_3: Disputes caused by private transactions, offline meetings, delegated actions, or information exchange initiated through communication are handled by users themselves.
app_agreement_section_risk_bullet_4: Sensitive information such as passwords, verification codes, payment credentials, and identity documents should not be disclosed in chats.
app_agreement_section_risk_bullet_5: The platform does not guarantee the safety or legality of third-party external links or mini-programs shared or accessed by users through this software. The user assumes all associated risks, including virus infections, property loss, or information leaks resulting from accessing or using third-party services.
app_agreement_section_judgement_body_1: You should maintain necessary caution in chats and group interactions, and independently decide whether to reply, share, meet offline, or continue engaging.
app_agreement_section_judgement_body_2: When abnormal situations occur, you should promptly stop the interaction and use your own measures to reduce loss.
app_agreement_section_judgement_bullet_1: Verify the other party through multiple channels before establishing deeper trust.
app_agreement_section_judgement_bullet_2: Keep records of key chats, transfers, files, or account identifiers when needed.
app_agreement_section_judgement_bullet_3: Use blocking, exiting groups, reporting, or contacting law enforcement where appropriate.
app_agreement_section_boundary_body_1: The APP provides technical services such as information display, transmission, and storage within available capability, but does not review or endorse every communication statement or user commitment.
app_agreement_section_boundary_body_2: The platform does not guarantee the authenticity, legality, or fulfillment outcome of communication content, nor does it assume substitute responsibility for user decisions.
app_agreement_section_boundary_body_3: Given the objective limitations of private communication technologies such as end-to-end messaging, the platform cannot and has no obligation to actively perform substantive or comprehensive reviews of users' peer-to-peer or private group communications. The platform only intervenes in accordance with the law upon receiving clear user reports or when the system identifies significant high-risk characteristics of suspected serious illegal acts.
app_agreement_section_update_body_1: This APP Agreement may be updated as products or risk-control requirements change. The latest version published in the app shall prevail.
app_agreement_section_update_body_2: Before registration or login, you should carefully read this page. Continuing to use related functions indicates that you understand and accept the APP risk notice, usage boundaries, and User Agreement.
user_agreement_page_subtitle: This agreement sets out service rules, rights and obligations, and responsibility boundaries for this instant messaging app.
user_agreement_section_scope_body_1: This agreement is entered into between you and Beijing Dahuangfeng Information Technology Co., Ltd. (北京大黄蜂信息科技有限公司, the platform operator), and applies to all service relationships created when you register, log in, or use this APP.
user_agreement_section_scope_body_2: By completing registration, logging in, or continuing to use the service, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to all terms of this agreement.
user_agreement_section_account_body_1: You shall provide true, accurate, and complete registration information and keep your contact details valid.
user_agreement_section_account_body_2: Unless you prove unauthorized use not caused by your fault, you are responsible for all activities under your account.
user_agreement_section_account_bullet_1: Keep your account, password, verification codes, and login credentials secure. Do not transfer, lend, or share your account.
user_agreement_section_account_bullet_2: If you detect account theft, credential leakage, or abnormal logins, promptly change your password and contact the platform.
user_agreement_section_account_bullet_3: You shall not buy, sell, rent, gift, or otherwise permit third parties to illegally use your account.
user_agreement_section_behavior_body_1: You shall use the service in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and social ethics, and must not infringe others rights through this APP.
user_agreement_section_behavior_bullet_1: Do not publish, transmit, store, or spread illegal or harmful content.
user_agreement_section_behavior_bullet_2: Do not send spam, malicious marketing, chain messages, or manipulate traffic with fake interactions.
user_agreement_section_behavior_bullet_3: Do not impersonate others, forge identities, scrape data without authorization, or mislead users.
user_agreement_section_behavior_bullet_4: Do not attack, intrude into, disrupt, reverse engineer, or otherwise compromise platform systems or data security.
user_agreement_section_content_body_1: Communication content is produced by users. You are responsible for the legality, authenticity, and consequences of the content you publish, forward, or store.
user_agreement_section_content_body_2: To maintain safety and compliance, the platform may review, identify, and handle violating content according to laws and platform rules.
user_agreement_section_content_bullet_1: For violations, the platform may take measures including warning, content removal, function restriction, temporary suspension, or permanent account ban.
user_agreement_section_content_bullet_2: Where content is suspected of involving illegal or criminal activity, the platform may preserve records and cooperate with competent authorities as required by law.
user_agreement_section_content_bullet_3: If you believe that content on the platform infringes your legal rights (such as copyright, reputation, etc.), you can submit a complaint to the platform with preliminary evidence. The platform will take appropriate actions, such as removing content or restricting accounts, in accordance with the law.
user_agreement_section_content_bullet_4: In response to serious illegal activities such as telecom fraud, gambling, or illicit content, the platform reserves the right to take emergency measures (such as blocking messages or freezing accounts) without prior notice based on risk control models or user reports, and bears no liability for resulting interruptions.
user_agreement_section_privacy_body_1: The platform handles your personal information in accordance with the published Privacy Policy and applicable laws and regulations.
user_agreement_section_privacy_body_2: You agree that the platform may process necessary data for registration and authentication, security control, message delivery, storage, and dispute handling.
user_agreement_section_minor_body_1: If you are a minor, read and agree to this agreement with your guardian, and use the service under guardian supervision.
user_agreement_section_minor_bullet_1: Guardians should guide minors to use communication features appropriately and prevent excessive use or unsafe interactions.
user_agreement_section_minor_bullet_2: If the platform identifies risks to minor users, it may take protective measures such as reminders, feature restrictions, or account controls.
user_agreement_section_service_body_1: The platform may adjust, upgrade, temporarily suspend, or remove service features based on operational, security, and compliance needs.
user_agreement_section_service_body_2: For service interruptions caused by maintenance, failures, network issues, or force majeure, the platform will make reasonable efforts to restore service.
user_agreement_section_service_bullet_1: For violations of this agreement, legal requirements, or security controls, the platform may suspend or terminate corresponding services and reserve the right to pursue legal liability.
user_agreement_section_fee_body_1: Unless otherwise stated, basic communication features may be provided free of charge, while your telecom and internet access costs shall be borne by you.
user_agreement_section_fee_bullet_1: Certain value-added features may require payment, and shall be subject to in-app product rules and payment instructions.
user_agreement_section_fee_bullet_2: Third-party links and services are provided by the relevant third parties and governed by their own terms.
user_agreement_section_liability_body_1: To the extent permitted by law, the platform shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages, including expected profit or data loss, except where caused by the platform intentional misconduct or gross negligence.
user_agreement_section_liability_body_2: Given the nature of instant communication, risks arising from your independent decisions, such as transfers, offline meetings, or external link access, are borne by you unless otherwise required by law.
user_agreement_section_liability_body_3: If the platform faces administrative penalties, third-party claims, or other losses due to your violation of laws, regulations, or this agreement, you shall fully compensate the platform for all such losses (including but not limited to fines, damages, litigation costs, attorney fees, etc.).
user_agreement_section_ip_body_1: Copyright, trademark, software, and other intellectual property rights in this APP and related service content belong to the platform or lawful rights holders and are protected by law.
user_agreement_section_ip_bullet_1: Without prior written permission, you shall not copy, modify, reverse engineer, distribute, lease, or create derivative works from platform software or content.
user_agreement_section_ip_bullet_2: You retain lawful rights to content you upload, but grant the platform a necessary, non-exclusive license to provide, maintain, and improve the service within legal scope.
user_agreement_section_dispute_body_1: The validity, interpretation, performance, and dispute resolution of this agreement shall be governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China (excluding conflict of law rules).
user_agreement_section_dispute_body_2: Disputes shall first be resolved through friendly negotiation. If negotiation fails, either party may file a lawsuit with a competent court in Beijing, China.
user_agreement_section_update_body_1: The platform may revise this agreement according to business changes, legal requirements, or risk control needs, and publish the updated version in the APP or via announcements.
user_agreement_section_update_body_2: This agreement takes effect on March 15, 2026. For questions, contact gcf@dhfeng.com. If you continue using the service after updated terms take effect, it is deemed that you accept the updated terms. If you disagree, stop using the service.
